column3: MT 5:21. “a person” renders “a soul (nefesh)”; “deceives” renders “denies (lies to),” and “a security entrusted to him” renders “a deposit of the hand.”
MT 5:24. “in full” renders “in its sum (head),” and “on the day he presents his guilt offering” renders “on the day of his guilt.”
MT 6:2. “the law” renders “the torah (instruction)” (also in verses 14 and 25).
MT 6:3. “his linen robe” renders “his linen garment”; NASB does not repeat “linen” for the undergarments, and “the ashes” renders “the fatty ashes.”
MT 6:4. “a clean place” renders “a pure place.”
MT 6:8. NASB supplies “one of them” for “he”; “incense” renders “frankincense (levonah).”
MT 6:10. “most holy” renders “a holy of holies” (also in verses 25 and 29).
MT 6:11. “a permanent ordinance” renders “a prescribed portion of perpetuity,” and “shall become consecrated” renders “will be holy.”
MT 6:14. “When it is well stirred” renders “mixed (murbeket),” and “baked pieces” renders a rare word whose meaning is uncertain.
MT 6:15. “entirely offered up” renders “a whole offering (kalil).”
MT 6:19. “offers it for sin” renders “makes it a sin offering.”
MT 6:20. “shall become consecrated” renders “will be holy.”
